verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can share spaces and collaborate with chosen people. They mention granting access to others, collaborators needing no email or subscription, peer-to-peer or self-hosted collaboration, and pins visible to everyone. Two HN comments say collaboration and sharing were not yet available, but they come from older launch-era threads and read as outdated rather than a concrete contradiction of current docs. Nothing in the pack shows how simultaneous edits are handled, which is the 'without stepping on each other's changes' part of the story. Missing for 10: documentation of real-time co-editing and conflict handling or merging, role/permission details, and independent hands-on confirmation that shared editing works.
